facts.fact: DPIIT startup recognition is applied for online on the National Single Window System (nsws.gov.in) by creating an account and adding the form 'Registration as a Startup'
facts.quote: To apply, create an account on NSWS and add form ‘Registration as a Startup’.

facts.fact: To be recognised, turnover must be under Rs 200 crore (Rs 300 crore for DeepTech) in every previous year and the entity counts as a startup for up to 10 years (20 for DeepTech) from incorporation
facts.quote: Turnover should be less than INR 200 Crores (INR 300 Crores for DeepTech startups) in any of the previous financial years. An entity shall be considered a startup for up to 10 years (20 years for DeepTech startups) from the date of its incorporation.

facts.fact: Tax benefit: after recognition and clearance, a startup can get a Section 80-IAC income-tax holiday for 3 consecutive financial years out of its first ten years
facts.quote: Post getting clearance for Tax exemption, the Startup can avail tax holiday for 3 consecutive financial years out of its first ten years since incorporation.

facts.fact: Only a recognised Private Limited company or LLP is eligible for the 80-IAC tax exemption
facts.quote: Only Private limited or a Limited Liability Partnership is eligible for Tax exemption under Section 80IAC

behaviour: Explains the DPIIT recognition process and the tax benefits as published on startupindia.gov.in, with citation.
fail_if: Says recognition alone gives the tax exemption without the separate 80-IAC application, invents a fee for recognition, or gives other turnover or age limits.
summary: Startup India page: apply via NSWS; turnover < Rs 200 cr (300 DeepTech), up to 10 (20) years; 80-IAC holiday 3 of first 10 years for Pvt Ltd/LLP after clearance.
